Copy a caption, copy the image, paste both into the channel.

Poster

1024 × 1280 · 4:5send as photo

Copy image is the one button a browser can refuse: putting a PNG on the clipboard goes through the permission-gated Clipboard API, which is withheld on plenty of local pages. When it says Blocked, use Save PNG and drag the file in — or drag docs/release-notes/v0.22.1-poster.png straight from the repo, which is the same bytes and skips the clipboard entirely. The caption buttons need no clipboard permission, so they are not the ones to worry about here. On a phone: press and hold the poster, then Save to Photos — and press and hold a caption rather than trusting its button — a phone browser is the case least tested here.

English

🎤 SingZ v0.22.1 — play means play, and the bit you marked stays marked

On the computer, a song with the click on but no beat grid yet plays instead of refusing to start. Mark a verse, leave repeat off, and it stops at the end of the mark on every Play, not just the first.

On your phone, changing training, the click or the count-in while it counts you in mid-song keeps your place instead of throwing the song back to the top. iPhone: if headphones or the car took over the sound between opening a song and pressing Play, Play follows it now.

The computer's count-in also stops blinking back to 0.00 when you hit Space fast.

Mac, Windows, Android: https://github.com/lexasoft123/SingZ/releases/latest
iPhone (TestFlight): https://testflight.apple.com/join/q6vVdkwt

Russian

🎤 SingZ v0.22.1 — Play значит «играй», а отмеченный фрагмент остаётся отмеченным

На компьютере песня, у которой ещё нет сетки долей, играет и с включённым метрономом, а не отказывается стартовать. Отметьте куплет, оставьте повтор выключенным — и воспроизведение остановится в конце отметки при каждом Play, а не только при первом.

На телефоне тренировка, метроном или отсчёт, переключённые во время отсчёта посреди песни, больше не отбрасывают песню в начало. iPhone: если между открытием песни и нажатием Play звук перешёл на наушники или машину, Play теперь следует за ним.

А отсчёт на компьютере больше не мигает обратно на 0.00, когда быстро нажимаете пробел.

Mac, Windows, Android: https://github.com/lexasoft123/SingZ/releases/latest
iPhone (TestFlight): https://testflight.apple.com/join/q6vVdkwt

Telegram allows 1024 characters on a photo caption and recompresses photos past ~1280 px on the long side — this poster is 1280 on its long side, so sending it as a photo costs nothing. Poster file: docs/release-notes/v0.22.1-poster.png
